_doc: Plans whose CAFR PDFs the cloud pipeline cannot fetch. These are SKIPPED EVERYWHERE by refresh_cafrs.py. Naming a blocked plan explicitly on the CLI still processes it, which is how the Mac Mini job fetches them from a residential IP.
_blocked_by: Same vocabulary as data/waf_blocked_plans.json, including the two-axis distinction between rendering a listing page and downloading the PDFs it links to. Probed 2026-09-01 from a residential IP. Two of the five (pbpr_pa, fwerf_tx) pass both axes and are Stage 1's; asrs, strs_ohio and acrs_pa render but 403 on the PDF itself, so the Mac Mini does not restore this list in full. An earlier revision of this file claimed it did -- that claim was made on discovery results alone, before downloads were tested.

plans.reason: Listing page renders from a residential IP, but the PDF path returns 403 to requests, to a cookie-carrying session, and to Playwright's own browser request context (probed 2026-09-01). Discovery without download is worthless, so no host we have can serve this plan.

_how_it_works: Loaded by refresh_cafrs.py, which subtracts every id here from the default plan set on every run, local or hosted -- 'blocked_by' does not affect that. Explicit positional plan_ids on the CLI bypass the filter. scripts/waf_blocked_ids.py reads 'blocked_by' to decide which ids the Mac Mini job should name.
